_comment: Which third-party websites the off-page checks look for the company on.
`default` is used on every scan. Choosing an industry and/or a region on the scan screen ADDS
that set's sites to the default lists -- nothing is taken away, so the core platforms are always
checked. Edit this file to add an industry, a region or a site; no code change is needed.
OFFPAGE_PLATFORMS_PATH points the app at a different file.
review     OFF-05 and OFF-06: B2B review and rating sites.
profile    OFF-03: business directories and company-profile sites.
community  OFF-07: discussion sites, searched alongside any URL containing 'forum' or 'community'.
Sites are bare domains (g2.com, not https://www.g2.com/). Scoring is unchanged by a longer list:
full presence marks need `platforms_for_full_marks` sites found (scoring_rules.json), whichever
sites of the active list those are.
